name: Geometry Shader (Quads)
aliases: Geometry Shader quads generated each frame from faces
definition: An extension where each GL_POINT represents a single face (quad) rather than a whole voxel, with a face index indicating which of the 6 quads to generate.
summary: Geometry Shader Quads renders volumetric data by generating one quad per visible voxel face, outputting only four vertices to reduce buffer space and improve GPU compatibility.
